cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the rent letter there and hold this curtain rail. A level line matters more than how it looks from the sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then he can have a photograph of a properly finished room. Your end is dropping; lift it two inches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's level. I'll send the photo and ask how much we owe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not from that angle. You'll make the rail look crooked. Hand me the phone and stand directly beneath it. Directly, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 expert leveling divert rent questions; A5 continues camera authority but ends in an unclear instruction.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 photo offer motivates camera correction, but A5 stand beneath it has an ambiguous object and no clear photographic purpose.

relationship.evidence: B2 deadline and B4 combined photo/rent offer give B an immediate reasonable concern.

heightening.evidence: A5 taking the phone follows B4; the added position does not earn a clear further development.

specificity.evidence: A1 rent and rail are clear; A5 it could refer to the phone or rail, and B position needs invented purpose.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 Directly please amplifies an instruction whose practical role is unclear.
